note: No program named Business Administration other than Business Administration MBA exists in programs; its groups match (6 foundational 2-credit courses with the Advanced Standing exemption note, 8 core MBAD courses, select 3 electives/9 credits), and the description gives 30-credit Advanced Standing (7 core + 3 electives) or 42-credit totals. The 40-64 credit undergraduate-major rule is in Integrity of Degree Programs; contacts appear in ASB pages/directory.

Nursing Accelerated BSN description matches (non-Nursing bachelor's or at least 60 credits, full-time daytime in-person), and the transfer admission-requirements page states ABSN applicants need a 3.0 cumulative GPA and links the ABSN requirements/instructions pages.
courses['CMPS 147']: 4 credits; prerequisite is any of MATH 021/022/024/100T/101/104/108/110/121 or one placement test (ACCUPLACER QR 258, AAF 260, ACT 26, SAT Math 580), exactly as stated.
Computer Science Minor groups: Group 1 select 3 and Group 2 select 2 with the same course lists (including the unnamed entry) and the Sequence 1/Sequence 2 prerequisite note; all match the data.

Nursing Generic BSN Pre-Nursing Courses: Science Courses (BIOL 212/212L, 214/214L, 216/216L, CHEM 111/111L, PSYC 101) and Math select 1 (MATH 108 or PSYC 242); description says all gen ed and science courses are completed before the two-year nursing sequence. PSYC 101 is actually in the same science group, not 'separately', but it is still reported as a science course.

ACCT 221 description, 4 credits, no requisites and empty attributes (no Gen Ed) all match. But asked whether it counts only toward 'the business major', it names only International Business BA, while the data lists it in the ASB Requirements of Accounting, Finance, Management, Marketing, ITM BS and Economics BA (plus minors and the Business Essentials Certificate); the four-course GEVE list is a partial, unasked aside (the data has ~47 GEVE courses).

No fixed Gen Ed credit total is published; Integrity of Degree Programs says it 'should not exceed 41 credits'. Provost curriculum page gives ten courses, the four keystone courses, four keystone categories (CRW 102 and QR within first 64 credits), two of three distribution categories with the out-of-school rule; CAP resources page uses 'Social Systems and Society' and says the out-of-school requirement is no longer enforced from Fall 2026.

Information Technology Management Fall 2026 plan (admitted 2026-2027): first-year fall INTD 101, CRWT 102, Gen Ed, MATH 108/110/121 (108 highly recommended), 16 credits; spring two Gen Eds, ECON 102, INFO 224, PATH 001, 16 credits. Student Success FAQ says FYS must be taken in first-year fall.

Programs list Data Analyst and Data Modeler graduate certificates and no project management certificate; BADM 501 (3 cr, no prereq), MBAD 664 (3 cr, no prereq), MGMT 472 (4 cr, prereq MGMT 370) match courses. No page establishes part-time availability. Calling Data Analyst only 'related' undersells it (its description is data/business analytics), but it is named.

Declining to read the transcript and the transfer facts (NJTransfer, A.A./A.S. accepted up to 65 credits, AAS course-by-course, Transfer Credit Worksheet, Convener review, advisement approval) match the transfer FAQs and catalog policy. But it calls International Business BA 'the bachelor's business major', which the data contradicts: ASB also offers Accounting, Finance, Management, Marketing and ITM BS majors.

Computer Science BS requirements (required CMPS/MATH courses, 2 math electives, 7 CS electives, PATH 001-003) match the data. But it says it cannot give IT required classes, while the Information Technology Management BS groups are published (QR select 1 of MATH 108/110/121, ASB core, INFO 233/332/335/342/441 + 3 INFO electives), and it refers IT questions to the School of Science, Nursing, and Health office though ITM BS is in the Anisfield School of Business.

MATH 108 has the GEQR attribute (other GEQR courses listed are a correct subset), QR must be done within the first 64 credits, 4 credits with prerequisites, and it is not in the MBA groups. But it stops at 'not established' for the business major, while every ASB bachelor's major in the data (incl. the International Business BA it names) has a Quantitative Reasoning select-1 group of MATH 108, MATH 110 or MATH 121.

Open sections and meeting times are not in the data. Registrar page says the Spring 2027 Schedule of Classes is available, the instructions page describes searching by subject and start/end time, and reg@ramapo.edu / (201) 684-7695 match.

No Business Administration bachelor's major exists; the MBA's published groups (foundational, core, 3 electives) have no concentrations, and its description gives only the 30- and 42-credit paths, as stated. ASB phone (201) 684-7379 and ASB@ramapo.edu appear on office pages.

Personal fit is advice; no clinical-hour schedules are published. ABSN 'full-time, daytime, in-person' and generic BSN two-years-then-nursing-sequence match; FOCUS 2 access code ramapo430, Career Center (201) 684-7444 / careercenter@ramapo.edu, and Nursing Programs Office (201) 684-7749 match the pages and directory.
